rejected_strategy.name: systemd-user-transient-service
rejected_strategy.reason: systemd 245 on this host uses hybrid/legacy resource controllers; inspected controller files are empty/root-owned and installed documentation disables user resource control. TasksMax/MemoryMax and IPAddressDeny settings therefore cannot prove enforcement.

selected_strategy.name: native-pidfd-subreaper-owner
requirements: Single-threaded native owner sets PR_SET_CHILD_SUBREAPER, blocks TERM/INT/CHLD before spawn and consumes signals synchronously with signalfd/poll.
Each child waits behind a pipe handshake until pidfd_open succeeds and an immutable spawn record is durable.
Only pidfd_send_signal targets owned direct/adopted children; numeric PID/PGID signalling is forbidden.
waitid(P_PIDFD, WEXITED|WNOHANG|WNOWAIT) observes status before explicit bounded reap; success requires all acquired children reaped and P_ALL returning ECHILD.
Cleanup deadline emits UNRESOLVED and retains the live subreaper and pidfds until acknowledged management handoff.
Start, spawn and terminal records are separate O_EXCL files with file and directory fsync; records are never rewritten.
Per-process limits remain enforced; aggregate process/RSS/storage polling is labelled observational until separate hard-cap infrastructure exists.
A reviewed no-new-privileges/seccomp child bootstrap must reject network socket/connect operations while preserving AF_UNIX socketpairs and descriptor tests.

non_releases: No owner implementation, compilation, execution profile or command is released.
No cleanup guarantee is claimed for owner SIGKILL, host failure, hostile same-UID mutation or uninterruptible tasks.
No application, production, language or whole-OS acceptance credit follows.
next: Implement the exact native owner source and deterministic static/fault-injection harness, independently review ownership and ABI, then obtain a separate reviewed bootstrap compile packet before executing it.
